definitions.explanation: The sharp cutting part of a knife, sword, or other cutting tool.

examples.japanese: {剃刀|かみそり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{刃|は}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{刃|は}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鈍|にぶ}く→鈍い：00315_nibui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The kitchen knife's blade has become dull.

notes:
{刃|は} refers to the cutting edge of bladed tools or weapons.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刃|は}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研|と}ぐ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧: to sharpen the blade
- {刃|は}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to replace the blade
- {刃|は}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧: the blade is sharp
- {刃|は}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鈍|にぶ}い→鈍い：00315_nibui⟧: the blade is dull

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{刃物|はもの}→刃物：11752_hamono⟧: edged tool, cutlery
- {両刃|りょうば}: double-edged
- {諸刃|もろは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{剣|つるぎ}: double-edged sword (figurative)

RELATED KANJI:
- ⟦{刃|やいば}→刃：19342_yaiba⟧: blade (especially of a sword) - different reading
